headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: May 24, 2026**
article:
The St. Louis Cardinals secured a crucial 8-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds, with Jordan Walker leading the offense. In other news, the Houston Astros shut out the Chicago Cubs 3-0, and the Toronto Blue Jays took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with Lourdes Gurriel Jr. of the Arizona Diamondbacks being placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Other notable injuries include Carter Baumler of the Texas Rangers, Jordan Hicks of the Chicago White Sox, and Ke'Bryan Hayes of the Cincinnati Reds.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place, including the Philadelphia Phillies trading RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies for future considerations and international bonus pool money. The Cincinnati Reds also traded RF Rece Hinds to the Miami Marlins for RHP Zach McCambley.

top_news.title: **Cardinals Cruise Past Reds 8-1**
top_news.summary: The St. Louis Cardinals dominated the Cincinnati Reds, securing an 8-1 victory. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a home run and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Edge Cardinals in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 7-6 victory over the St. Louis Cardinals in a closely contested matchup. Jordan Walker led the Cardinals' offense with a 3-hit, 1-home run, 4-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Astros Shut Out Cubs 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured a shutout victory over the Chicago Cubs, with a final score of 3-0. Christian Walker led the Astros' offense with a 3-for-3 performance, including two home runs and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Pirates Fall to Blue Jays in Toronto**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays took down the Pittsburgh Pirates 5-2, securing a win on the road. Patrick Corbin led the Blue Jays to victory with 6.0 innings pitched, 7 strikeouts, and 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Gurriel Jr. Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks left fielder Lourdes Gurriel Jr. has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain.

top_news.title: **Phillies Make Roster Move**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Andrew Baker to the Colorado Rockies on May 22, 2026, in exchange for future considerations and international bonus pool money.
